subject: Cross-border settlement: proposed partial credit + escrow wire flow
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@ediflow.health>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@ediflow.health>, Ediflow AP <ap@ediflow.health>
Date: 2026-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Duplicate usage billing Aug — request for partial settlement + wire through escrow

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. We did a deeper look at our July/early-August invoices and found a duplicate ingestion event between July 28–29 that caused roughly $18,200 in overcharges across our EU tenant (two parallel connectors sent the same payload during a deploy). I attached our calc (ediflow_credit_calc.xlsx) and a copy of the July invoice excerpt.

Because we are cross-border and our AP needs a clear audit trail, we have two asks:
- Can Redwood issue a formal credit note for the overbilled portion and confirm VAT treatment for the credit?
- Given internal signoffs for Ediflow, we'd prefer Redwood to process the settlement via an escrow/wire flow (GlobalEscrow) rather than an immediate account credit. This helps our treasury team reconcile and avoids local withholding disputes.

We can provide the VAT registration (EU-MT-45231) and bank beneficiary details once you confirm this approach. Also attaching a payment proof for the original wire (payment_proof.pdf) to show the invoice was paid.

Appreciate a note on timeline and whether Redwood needs any additional evidence from our side.

Best,
Asha
Director, Finance — Ediflow Health
Attachments: ediflow_credit_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet), payment_proof.pdf (pdf)
From: monica.patel@redwood.com <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@ediflow.health>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@ediflow.health>, Ediflow AP <ap@ediflow.health>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Duplicate usage billing Aug — request for partial settlement + wire through escrow

Hi Asha,

Thanks for the detailed breakdown and the attachments — that was helpful. We're sorry about the duplicate ingestion; that aligns with a connector-version bug our runtime team rolled back on Aug 1.

Proposed path forward (quick):
1) We will issue a provisional goodwill credit note for the confirmed overbilled amount but recommend netting for any withholding implications.
2) Since you asked for escrow, Redwood can coordinate with GlobalEscrow to execute a wire to your nominated beneficiary and then apply a matching service credit to your account so your ledger stays clean.
3) To complete this, we need:
   - Confirmed VAT registration number (you listed EU-MT-45231 — please confirm the company name exactly as registered)
   - Bank beneficiary details (IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, beneficiary name) for the escrow flow
   - A single point of contact in AP for the GlobalEscrow team (email + phone)

Internal note: tagging Marcus (collections) and Stephanie (tax) to validate the escrow workflow, timing, and tax treatment for a cross-border credit note. We'll propose a credit amount below after internal review.

If you can get the VAT/bank details to me by EOD Monday 8/16 we'll target issuing the credit note and initiating the escrow on Tuesday.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Revenue Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0132
From: monica.patel@redwood.com <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Duplicate usage billing Aug — request for partial settlement + wire through escrow

Marcus / Stephanie — forwarding Ediflow's request. Key points:
- Overbill ~18.2k USD, cross-border (EU) tenant; they prefer escrow/wire to keep AP reconciliation straightforward.
- They provided calc + payment proof (attached).
- We should consider issuing a partial cash-equivalent credit but route the outgoing funds through GlobalEscrow to their beneficiary to avoid messing with VAT withholding.

Questions for you:
- Marcus: can Collections handle a one-off escrow remittance and sync the credit note application to the account? Any approvals needed for >$10k goodwill?
- Stephanie: what VAT evidence do we need to include on the credit note to avoid treating it as taxable supply in the EU? If we apply a credit note and then wire funds via escrow, do we need to gross-up or show net-of-withholding?

I propose a provisional credit of $12,400 (net) while we confirm withholding exposures; we may need to top-up depending on tax advice. Please advise ASAP so I can update the customer.

— Monica
From: monica.patel@redwood.com <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@ediflow.health>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@ediflow.health>, Ediflow AP <ap@ediflow.health>, GlobalEscrow Ops <ops@globalescrow.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Duplicate usage billing Aug — request for partial settlement + wire through escrow

Hi Asha / Rajiv,

Thanks for confirming the VAT ID (EU-MT-45231) and sending beneficiary details earlier today. Per our internal review (collections + tax) Redwood will do the following:

1) Issue a formal credit note (RWI-CN-20260814.pdf) for the confirmed overcharge; the credit note will reference your invoice #RWF-2026-07-117 and include the VAT reversal statement for EU-MT-45231.

2) Redwood will simultaneously initiate a wired settlement of USD 12,400 via our escrow partner (GlobalEscrow). The wire amount is the agreed goodwill settlement net of any potential withholding exposures; if tax/treaty research indicates a required gross-up we will notify you within 3 business days.

3) Timeline: credit note issued today; GlobalEscrow will request beneficiary confirmation from Ediflow AP and expects to execute the wire within 5 business days of confirmation.

Action items for Ediflow:
- Please confirm beneficiary IBAN: MT84MALT01100001234500012345601 and confirm beneficiary legal name exactly as on bank account.
- Provide a named AP contact for the escrow ops team (email + phone).

Attachments: RWI-CN-20260814.pdf (credit note stub).

If you prefer the credit to be applied directly to your Redwood account balance instead of a wire, let me know and we can switch flows; we suggested escrow because you flagged treasury reconciliation requirements.

Thanks — I'll remain the point of contact until the transaction completes.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Revenue Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachments: RWI-CN-20260814.pdf (pdf)
--end--
